narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A humorous vlog documenting the creator's first experience trying to purchase concert tickets online. It uses a high-energy comedic style to portray the transition from over-preparedness and excitement to the frantic chaos and eventual despair of failing to secure tickets due to website lag and high demand.
